answer.why: Harbour City's pressure rise (+5.20 sd) is best explained by a tactical increase in pressing (supported by a sprint-count corollary +3.52 sd); chasing_result also predicts the same pressure rise but has no corollary, while Northvale's protecting_lead explains the long-ball jump (+7.17 sd) but only re-measures that change and is weakened by the weak fall in their pressure rate.
